`final class ManualClockBridge`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IClockBridge`](/reference/bridges/iclockbridge/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.clock` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ManualClockBridge.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/clock/ManualClockBridge.java)

A clock that moves only when you set or advance it, so that every animation gives the same frame on every run.

## Description

Register it above the system clock in a test, then unregister it at the end: the system clock takes over again.

This method plays frames 16 ms apart, whatever time they take:

```java file="com/example/backend/SteppedFrames.java" region="clock"
```

## Learn more

- [Use a manual clock in a test](/build/bridges/clock/#use-a-manual-clock-in-a-test)
